evidence.title: Çift kart kaydı
evidence.text: Yedinci odanın kilit kaydı: 22:38’de 7A kartı (Nermin A.), 22:44’te 7B kartı. 7B sabah kurbanın çantasında bulundu; oysa Nermin içeri 7A ile girmişti. 22:44’te ikinci kart başka birinin elindeydi.

evidence.title: 11 dakikalık kamera döngüsü
evidence.text: Üçüncü kat koridor kamerası 22:41–22:52 arasında boş koridoru gösteriyor. Saat damgası akıyor, ama yangın çıkışı lambasındaki titreme her 40 saniyede bir birebir aynı tekrar ediyor: görüntü döngüye alınmış.

items.label: Yangın lambası
items.text: Titreşim her 40 saniyede bir BİREBİR aynı tekrar ediyor.

evidence.title: Islak boya kokusu
evidence.text: Yedinci odada keskin bir yumurta temperası kokusu var. Kapı kolunda ve kurbanın yakasında taze okra izi. Okra, lobideki freskin restorasyonunda kullanılan karışım; ekibin boyaları her akşam restorasyon deposunda kilit altında tutuluyor.

items.label: İz
items.text: Kapı kolunda ve kurbanın yakasında taze OKRA boya.

items.label: Depo

evidence.title: Soğumuş kahve
evidence.text: Lobideki iskelenin basamağında ağzına kadar dolu, soğumuş bir kahve fincanı. Yüzeyinde kaymak tabakası oluşmuş; kimse dokunmamış. Oda servisi kaydı: 22:45, müdür Arda S. tarafından iskeleye götürüldü.

items.label: Olay yeri notu
items.text: Fincan ağzına kadar dolu, soğuk; yüzeyde kaymak tabakası, DOKUNULMAMIŞ.

evidence.title: Santral kaydı
evidence.text: Resepsiyon hattı 22:39 ve 22:43’te çaldı; ikisi de cevapsız kaldı. Arayan: müdür odası. Resepsiyondan bir sonraki işlem 22:53’te yapılmış.

evidence.title: Faks kaydı
evidence.text: 18:02’de restorasyon raporunun 14 sayfası müdür odasındaki faksa gönderilmiş. Kapak notu: “Arda Bey, rapor yarın sabah Lumeris Miras Kurulu’na gidiyor. — N.A.”

evidence.title: Two key cards
evidence.text: The lock log for the seventh room: card 7A (Nermin A.) at 22:38, card 7B at 22:44. In the morning 7B turned up in the victim's bag, yet Nermin had let herself in with 7A. At 22:44 the second card was in someone else's hand.

evidence.title: The eleven-minute loop
evidence.text: Between 22:41 and 22:52 the third-floor corridor camera shows an empty hallway. The timestamp keeps running, but the flicker of the fire-exit light repeats exactly, frame for frame, every forty seconds: the picture has been looped.

items.label: Fire-exit light
items.text: The flicker repeats EXACTLY every 40 seconds.

items.label: Tech note
items.text: The picture may have been looped.

evidence.title: Smell of wet paint
evidence.text: The seventh room reeks of egg tempera. Fresh ochre on the door handle and on the victim's collar. Ochre is the mix used to restore the lobby fresco; every evening the team's paints are locked away in the restoration storeroom.

items.label: Trace
items.text: Fresh OCHRE paint on the door handle and the victim's collar.

items.label: Source
items.text: Ochre is the restoration mix for the lobby fresco.

items.label: Storeroom
items.text: The team's paints are locked in the restoration store every evening.

evidence.title: Cold coffee
evidence.text: On a step of the lobby scaffold, a cup of coffee filled to the brim and long gone cold. A skin has formed on the surface; nobody touched it. Room-service slip: taken to the scaffold at 22:45 by the manager, Arda S.

items.label: Scene note
items.text: Cup full to the brim, cold; a skin on the surface, UNTOUCHED.

evidence.title: Switchboard log
evidence.text: The reception line rang at 22:39 and again at 22:43; both calls went unanswered. Caller: the manager's office. The next action logged at the front desk is at 22:53.

evidence.title: Fax log
evidence.text: At 18:02, all fourteen pages of the restoration report were faxed straight to the manager's office. Cover note: "Arda — this goes to the Lumeris Heritage Board first thing tomorrow. — N.A."

items.label: Cover note
items.text: "Arda — this goes to the Lumeris Heritage Board tomorrow morning. — N.A."

evidence.title: Key card slip
evidence.text: The front-desk card ledger: card 7B issued at 19:10. Note: "occupant's sister." Signed for by E. A. Issued by R. D.

evidence.title: The coded recording
evidence.text: Nermin's dictaphone. 20:15: "Ece asked for money again. I said no again; it doesn't sit right with me." 21:50: "Inventory seven-K. The 1931 plan confirms it: the panel is behind the wall. But someone found it before I did; the plaster on that wall is fresh. I'm reporting it to the Board tomorrow."

evidence.text: A 1931 floor plan from the municipal archive. A service corridor that appears on no modern plan runs from the restoration storeroom to the back door of the security office, and up to the wall of the seventh room on the third floor. On today's plan the same space is marked "sealed, 1990."
